headline: XIAO MA climbs from 108th to ARC-2 gold line

sections.text: XIAO MA added 8.06 points to reach 40.56, leaping from 108th to 17th in the past day.
At 17th, XIAO MA is just outside the 15 public gold places; the current cutoff is 41.81. The standings are provisional, with medals decided on the private board.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
